title: plagiobothrys foliaceus
intro: Plagiobothrys foliaceus, commonly known as leafy false flax, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Plagiobothrys foliaceus include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as diarrhea, fever, and skin infections.
